notes.zh-CN: 接入百度 Comate（comate-acp）。移除 302.AI Media Studio，以及作曲器里的 302.AI Coding 入口；302.AI 仍可作为普通 API 提供商或 Claude API 预设。手机端改为模型列表对话框，可刷新，并在列表失败或同步服务过旧时提示。目录探测失败不再把已经连上的对话标成断开。macOS 为 universal 开发签名、未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队已注册设备，均非商店包。
notes.en: Adds Baidu Comate (comate-acp). Removes 302.AI Media Studio and the 302.AI Coding composer entry; 302.AI remains available as a normal API provider or a Claude API preset. The mobile app uses a model-list dialog that can refresh, and reports when the list fails or the sync service is too old. A failed catalog probe no longer marks an already connected chat as disconnected. macOS is universal and development-signed, not notarized; Windows installers are unsigned; APK is debug-signed; IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only. These are not store builds.
